UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE SOUTHERN DISTRICT OF NEW YORK
Civil Action No. 1:26-cv-04172

SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT AND RELEASE

This Settlement Agreement is entered into on September 14, 2026 between Thomas Whitacre and Halvorsen Example Logistics Inc.

1. Mr. Whitacre resides at 1180 Example Boulevard, Apartment 6C, Brooklyn, NY 11201.

2. Halvorsen Example Logistics Inc. shall pay Mr. Whitacre the sum of $85,000.00 within thirty days.

3. Notices to Mr. Whitacre shall be sent to his counsel, Dr. Agatha Pemberton-Lowe, who may be reached at (212) 555-0147.

4. This Agreement resolves all claims in the action pending before the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York.
